PokéMulti adapts Dramaless Shape 2.0.4 camera presets, coordinate conventions, shape fallback rules, face shading, world curvature, tilt-shift and settings to FireRed and Direct3D 11. Original archive SHA256: 4eadaf2b41d16ff5eecf965bc464fc56bedbf7a4d2550566a2a63517f611c372. Upstream: https://github.com/artyrambles/DRAMALESS_SHAPE . Gen1Recomp Lua engine internals and Gen 1 building tile IDs are not a GBA API. The original supplied ZIP and extracted sources are retained unchanged under Voxel Renderer. See LICENSE and CREDITS.md.


0.14 scenery adaptation: `src/voxel/structures.cpp` ports the banded silhouette/solid/shell approach in `lib/Buildings.lua` and the quantized circular chords, front/back rows, side-material samples, cap-interior samples and ground-foot rules in `lib/Structures.lua` (`roundTemplate`). `lib/ChunkMesher.lua` supplies the folded upright-surface reference and `lib/VoxelLoadingVeil.lua` informs holding complete voxel presentation during native loads. GBA foreground transparency replaces GB luminance segmentation where available. Native complete tree drawings preserve the trunk stored in the base layer; source textures remain unchanged. FireRed structure coordinates, roof bands, signs and roof-fixture bounds are authored in the adapter. Gen 1 profiles are not reused as FireRed tile IDs. General-tileset trees/bushes and surveyed Kanto structures have dedicated profiles; unprofiled scenery retains fallback geometry.

Shoreline closure also follows `ChunkMesher.lua`: dry terrain and model plots emit cropped 8-pixel side bands down to a lower water neighbour. These faces share terrain chunk culling so a bank cannot disappear on long maps.

0.15 extends the source translation with `TileShape.at` class priority, `Structures.buildVolume` repeat/trim/region-height and uniform-body rules, `Structures.buildObject` component placement and constant-texel exposed faces, `PINNED_DEPTH` signpost=2/post=6, `ChunkMesher` 8px top/upright bands and neighbour culling, and `VoxelScene.groundAt`. FireRed behavior and foreground references provide the corresponding pins. The prior hue-count classifier, procedural dome fallback and first-pixel stretched tops are removed. Detailed source mapping and limitations are in docs/VOXEL_REFERENCE.md.

`roundGround` also adapts the `roundTemplate` squared-RGB floor matching rule. Native FireRed background-apron colours replace the four GB light/white shades, excluding the silhouette and cast shadow; native floor metatiles repeat at 16 pixels. Original asset pixels are unchanged.


0.16 translates `TiltShift.lua`'s two separable nine-tap Gaussian passes, exact presets and spacing clamp into HLSL and Direct3D targets. Original sprite/HUD composition stays separate. The connected terrain adapter follows `ChunkMesher.lua`'s neighbor-body priority over the authored border ring, using FireRed connections and each map's original tileset instead of Gen 1 block IDs.
